text: PART III - LANDS Title Registration NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE Rൾ඀ංඌඍඋൺඍංඈඇ ඈൿ Tංඍඅൾ Aർඍ, Nඈ. 21 ඈൿ 1998 (Sൾർඍංඈඇ 55) REFERENCE the intestate property of late Mr. Udawattage Don Liveters Gunasiri who resides in the village of Katubaddha, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Moratuwa, in the District of Colombo. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Udawattage Don Liveters Gunasiri described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 14th October 2024 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, exparte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. P.C.D. SIGERA, Commissioner General of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 06th September, 2024.
